prerequisites: Basics of computer science and programming
basics of using data files and applications of analytical methods.

learning_outcomes.text: The student analyzes the obtained or provided data using appropriate software. Performs basic programming tasks for analytical tasks.

The student identifies elements of modern information technologies, analyzes the components of the information system: software, platforms, programming language languages, libraries, types of data sources, data types, method resources. Draws attention to the continuous development in the field of information technologies, which requires constant supplementation of knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Methods of data integration, preparation and analysis using selected modern tools and platforms, including in the cloud.
Methods of developing analysis results and reports using selected modern tools and platforms.
Use of CSV files - integration and analysis of two-dimensional data structures.
Data modeling, data types in statistics and levels of measurement.
Data science fundamentals and empirical research.
Democratizing the use of data and data science in the enterprise.
Examples of applications of data analysis and machine learning.
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the assessment of individual projects is 60.0%. This assessment constitutes 100.0% of the final grade.

Simon Asplen-Taylor, "Data and Analytics Strategy for Business: Unlock Data Assets and Increase Innovation with a Results", Kogan 2022.
Nussbaumer Knaflic Cole, "Storytelling with Data", John Wiley & Sons 2020.
